items.title: Ernest Roubleau Interview, 1961-10-18
items.q: and I told him the sweet trumpet player was Peter Lacalle.

ctx.x: didn't have no special arrangement uh at that time uh this fella punch he was blowing trumpet for jack yeah sometime when they couldn't get the punch he'd get uh uh when buddy wouldn't have anything to do he'd get buddy all right when buddy had something to do well uh he'd get a fella by the name of his he's kind of a blacksmith fella i think
and I told him the sweet trumpet player was Peter Lacalle. Oh, no, I think he's still living.
I've never met him, though. I think he's down in St. Bernard Avenue.
